info.description:
Read-only access to a running batcontrol instance: control state, battery,
price/solar/consumption forecasts and the decision trace that explains why
batcontrol chose the current inverter mode.

**This API never changes anything.** Every endpoint is a GET. Runtime
overrides stay on the MQTT API.

Conventions:

* Timestamps are epoch **milliseconds** (the MQTT API uses seconds).
* Energy is **Wh per forecast slot**; energy series also carry `power_w`, the
  average power over the slot. At 15-minute resolution those differ by a
  factor of four.
* Prices are EUR/kWh with 4 decimals.
* Forecast slot 0 is the interval containing the current time. Slots that
  have passed since the last control cycle are not returned.
info.summary: Read-only API of a running batcontrol instance
info.title: batcontrol

get.description: State of charge, capacities and the SoC limits. Values are the ones cached by the last control cycle - reading this endpoint never queries the inverter.

The parameters that explain batcontrol's behaviour. This is an explicit allow-list of runtime values, not a dump of the configuration file: inverter passwords, tariff tokens and MQTT credentials are not reachable from here.
Convenience endpoint for dashboards: the current price is always populated, independent of which decision path ran. Returns 503 until the first control cycle has completed.
